item.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call recaps in Queues app
item.description: Spend less time catching up on call recordings to resolve customer issues faster. For recorded call queue calls, the Queues app now supports intelligent call recaps for recorded calls that includes AI-generated summary notes, key discussion points, and follow-up actions. Navigate to the call record (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI integration in M365 Copilot
item.description: This release enables M365 Copilot to reason over Power BI enterprise data and returns grounded answers directly from Power BI reports and semantic models. Users can ask natural‑language questions and receive accurate answers. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live Light theme support
item.description: Presenting PowerPoint slides in Teams just got better. PowerPoint Live now supports light mode, giving presenters the option to present in light, dark, classic, or high contrast mode based on their preferences and system settings. (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Block all identified external bots automatically from joining your meetings
item.description: Extending the admin controls provided for managing external AI bots and regulating their access to your meetings, we are adding the option to automatically block all identified bots. (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Mandatory pre-meeting consent
item.description: We are providing a new configuration experience in Teams Admin Center where tenant admins can enable and customize an explicit consent message before joining any meeting hosted in their organization. (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Updates to Memory and Personalization in Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Copilot will use chat history for more relevant responses, with updated settings for managing memory and personalization preferences. (GA: December CY2025) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Domain exclusion for web grounding
item.description: Admins can exclude specific websites from web grounding in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. This feature impacts IT admins managing Copilot settings. (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Copilot admin configuration assistance
item.description: A Copilot-powered conversational assistant embedded in the Viva Glint admin experience that answers configuration and how-to questions and provides step-by-step guidance. Responses will include deep links to configuration pages streamlining navigation and discoverability. Only available for Viva Gli (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Unified Agent and App Installation Management Across Microsoft 365 and Teams Admin Center
item.description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center will be able to apply app and agent installation changes once and have them consistently enforced across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 Copilot. Previously, installation changes made in the Microsoft 365 admin center only (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: OneNote: Copilot Notebook in OneNote on Mac
item.description: Copilot Notebook, an AI-powered workspace for a project or topic built on reference materials, is coming to OneNote on Mac. Bring together your work context behind a project in one place. (GA: August CY2026) — OneNote

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
item.description: Intelligent summaries in the Copilot Dashboard will highlight adoption trends and areas for improvement. This change affects admins monitoring Copilot usage. (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Viva, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Outlook: Print calendar events in new Outlook and Teams
item.description: Users will now have basic options for printing calendar events in #newoutlookforwindows and Teams calendar, including choosing whether to show all attendees or display a shortened list of up to 10 attendees via a checkbox. (GA: March CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: The updated Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android prioritizes video on the meeting stage, arranges participants in consistent aspect ratios, and minimizes movement of participant tiles on stage.
